name: Decimate lets the Shadow Hounds ignore armor (#3718)
contract: Decimate 804194 reads 'Empowers your Shadow Hounds ..., granting them $s1% increased damage and haste and allowing them to ignore Armor'. In the client Spell.dbc (2026-09-17) its three SPELL_EFFECT_ASCENSION_APPLY_AURA_TO_SUMMONS effects carry aura 79 (+30% damage), aura 280 (MOD_ARMOR_PENETRATION_PCT, 99 + 1 = 100) and aura 192 (+30% haste); SpellAuras.cpp copies each to the owner's summons. Unit::CalcArmorReducedDamage reads aura 280 only for players (and Primalist's Sharpened Claws on pets), so a hound's hits stay fully mitigated. Aura 338 SPELL_AURA_ASCENSION_MOD_IGNORE_ARMOR_PCT is read for any attacker and a 100% amount removes all armor, so the module retargets effect 1 to it (Sun Cleric Vindicator precedent); the full ignore, not the player armor-penetration formula, is the literal reading of 'ignore Armor'. armor_reduced_damage applies the native armor mitigation to a base of 1000 as the hound: below 1000 before Decimate, exactly 1000 (no mitigation) after. Pommel Smash 680515 is only a physical-school spell for the probe. Harvest Golem 36 is the armored target.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Armor mitigates the hound before Decimate (1000 base, so armor is above zero)
Decimate's damage clause reaches the hound (effect 0, 29 + 1 = 30%)
Decimate's armor clause reaches the hound (effect 1, 99 + 1 = 100%)
The hound now ignores all armor
